nativeSource: Official installed DeepSeek Harness desktop package

changes: Model offers bounded optional tasks without executing them; only owner confirmation admits isolated workspaces or a human queue request.
Ignorable session records preserve admission identities; cold dismissal and persistent prompt preferences use the native storage domain without activating agents.
Native composer cards and opt-out ghost prompts adopt through revision-guarded input actions without auto-send or background suggestion inference.
Owner-only saved local environments with portable definitions, machine-scoped folder bindings and write-only credential-backed variables.
Public workspace preparation helpers share native preflight, permission inheritance and reserved setup identities with confirmed follow-ups.
Session-scoped native PowerShell/PTY overlays, native worktree preparation and fresh conversations with independent repository sandbox roots.
Recent folders and environment management in native settings and a sidebar footer dialog; preserves existing drafts and histories.
Native settings section for the separate idle maintenance capability; uses ConfigForms and Switch without a second settings store.
Native chat file mentions also resolve plain workspace paths from assistant markdown, opening the existing sidebar preview; produced or delivered matches still win.
Wraps the pinned host 0.2.1-rc.2 chatFileMentions.forClosing surface without registering a second service or touching styles.
Await one-shot headless write-back before disposal.
Remove the hardcoded ten-minute gate on summary updates.
Enforce session memory-write restrictions across automatic capture, explicit tools and inherited linked sessions.
Durable last-20 side conversation pairs.
Tool-enabled background-session promotion.
Native Ctrl+Alt+Shift+B side-question dialog preserves the main composer draft.
Child-scoped prompt assembly removes inherited and child-local tools from answer-only requests.
Code-only restore through the original snapshot journal under native maintenance lock.
Desktop slash entries for persistent agents and session navigation.
Linked task roles for independent implementation/review; native sidebar hierarchy and conversation-level progress, with the redundant global panel removed.
Native status Map drives pending-interaction precedence and attention counts; stopped tasks retain their lifecycle state.
Parallel writer guidance pins the delivery checkout/base, returns before each native worktree allocation, and requires reviewed integration before acceptance.
Explicit messages queue at the next turn; native cancellation and user ingress fence stopped-state races, with sender/recipient checks after async resolution and bounded terminal-report guards.
On-demand task and recent-turn recap reads exact native projections without activating agents or duplicating task storage; remains accessible while the native question card replaces the todo dock.

Side-by-side linked conversations reuse native retained session references, SessionProvider and embedded Conversation factory in a native right-sidebar tab; independent drafts and native permissions remain scoped to each session.

Background completion notices use ephemeral actual-turn records, existing access/stop/archive checks, an additive native overlay and already-authorized Web Notifications; local mute preference, initial-history suppression and per-turn deduplication preserve user control.

Explicit per-caller transient authorization enables bounded cross-workspace local history roster/read tools without inheriting grants, activating targets or widening family controls; grant versions fence asynchronous revocation.

Global session status groups use a native terminal-event projection and bounded read-only metadata RPC; a native sidebar footer popover preserves the workspace hierarchy without restoring a global collaboration page or making model calls.
Trusted linked dispatch propagates caller cancellation across queued admission and target resolution; remote send keeps its existing wire schema.
Cross-cwd sidebar lineage uses disposable navigation aliases and native status/navigation; native workspace ownership and history remain unchanged, with archive/view-switch restoration.

Alias row menus reuse live native registered components, business injections, locale and shortcuts through an owned slot and native Menu portal; original entry lifecycle is respected without duplicating CRUD.
Fresh and forked workers inherit the parent's memory-write boundary through the memory plugin's public service before dispatch.
Viewport-contained annotation send controls and independent region screenshot cropping; native click/drag and input regression.
Token and elapsed-time budgets per run, lowerable per call; an exhausted budget refuses further agent() calls while the script still returns gathered results.
Size-guideline warning when a run starts more agents than the deployment's threshold.
One-level nesting guard: a workflow child session may not start another workflow.
Per-run JSONL journal and prefix replay behind resume_from_run_id, stopping at the first changed agent() call.

schemaRetries (default 5): a child that finished completed without the structured value its schema asked for is replaced by a fresh child with the same request; failed or cancelled children are not retried, tokens accumulate, and only the final attempt is journaled.
sizeGuideline config states the expected agent scale in the tool description and forwards the matching warning threshold to the engine.
resume_from_run_id, budget_tokens, and budget_ms parameters forwarded to the engine on both foreground and background starts.
